notes.title: Introduction to & Community Opening
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are TwinChariot, a two-person indie dev team from Korea (formed by twin sisters 😆).[/p][p]Through this community, we’ll be sharing updates on development and gathering your feedback to make the game even better.[/p][p][/p][h2]What is XX Fulfillment Center?[/h2][h3]📦 Papers, Please + Fulfillment Center = ?![/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693900/526512c7407e5758a214072f7b0a633f3bb56f10.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693900/e47ad425692ea9ecb2e18ad0d6923efa63b017a9.gif"][/img][/h3][p][b]XX Fulfillment Center[/b] is a game inspired by titles such as [i]Papers, Please[/i] and [i]No Umbrellas Allowed[/i].
While drawing inspiration from those works, we aim to deliver a unique experience with an engaging story and gameplay systems such as:[/p][list][*][p]Fast-paced [b]packing gameplay[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Exploration segments to [b]uncover hidden secrets[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Over [b]16 different endings[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Do you have any questions about the game, or parts of the story you’re most curious about?
Feel free to leave your thoughts here—we’d love to hear from you![/p][p]Thank you always for your support.
– TwinChariot[/p]

notes.title: BIC Festival 2025 – Winner of the "Excellence in Social Impact" Award!
notes.content:
[p]We are honored to announce that <[i]XX Fulfillment Center>[/i] has received the [b]Excellence in Social Impact Award[/b] at [i]BIC Festival 2025[/i]!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693900/d15bbe534dd8b026c504df8e2c780d14181560a4.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to this award, we were also selected for the [b]BIGEM 4th[/b], and recognized as one of the [b]Top Indie Games in the Online Pavilion (Playthroughs / Views / Downloads)[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693900/d4a14fca92c3f1502ec9f32401f0ffb69d60abf4.jpg"][/img]We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the BIC Festival for this wonderful opportunity, as well as to all the players and developers who shared valuable feedback and supported us with their encouragement.
[/p][p][i]XX Fulfillment Center[/i] will continue striving to become a better game by reflecting on the feedback we received during the exhibition.
Thank you for your continued support![/p]
